This is the official unboxing video of the new Galaxy S26 FE. An essential design to frame your everyday, with features to make the most of every moment ✨ 

At just 7.4 mm thin and 193 g light, Galaxy S26 FE looks sleek and is built tough, with Corning® Gorilla® Glass Victus+® and an aluminum alloy frame. Pick your signature shade from three distinctive colors—Pistachio, Graphite, and Blueberry, each thoughtfully selected to complement your everyday life. The 6.7” FHD+ display with a smooth 120 Hz refresh rate brings your content to life, while the 4900 mAh battery keeps you going throughout the day. 

Ready for your close-up? 📸 Fit more into every selfie with the 12 MP Selfie Camera, or capture the moment with the 50 MP Wide-angle Camera, 12 MP Ultra Wide Camera, and 8 MP Telephoto Camera, with 50 MP zoom technology helping preserve sharp details even when you zoom in.
